title: Looking for feedback from players not familiar with energy systems
author: Electricvid
selftext:
I've had the idea for this game in my head for [almost 10 years](https://www.reddit.com/r/engineering/comments/5hp6sc/anybody_interested_on_working_on_a_energyeconomy/), and three months ago, I finally started turning it into reality!

It's been an intense few months, and the game has come a long way. Looking back at the earliest versions, it's honestly crazy how much has changed.

So far, I've received a lot of great feedback, mostly from people with a background in energy systems. But my goal has always been to make a game that's **easy to learn but hard to master**, even if you know absolutely nothing about energy.

That's why I'd really love to hear from a broader range of players!

If you enjoy tycoon, management, or strategy games, I'd love for you to give it a try and tell me what you think. Especially whether the game feels approachable for someone without an engineering background.

You can play the first 10 in-game years completely free, which should give you plenty of time to get a feel for it :)

by the way: If you are interested in how I've developed it I'm obviously fully open to any advice / insight I can give. 

**Play here:** [www.powerstate-game.com](https://www.powerstate-game.com/)

Any feedback is genuinely appreciated!
